code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low oxygen saturation, low pO₂), with mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (lymphopenia, neutropenia, monocytosis, basophilia). Elevated RDW and alkaline phosphatase are noted. These findings suggest significant respiratory compromise with possible underlying infection, bone marrow suppression, or systemic illness. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
